digest.en: Global / Multilateral leads the board this hour with Large gatherings and small talk – I used to think they were superficial but I now see how they keep. Asia-Pacific carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका की अगुवाई है, सह-मेजबान कनाडा का सफर समाप्त, लगातार दूसरी बार विश्व कप के क्वार्टर फाइनल में मोरक्को मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Large gatherings and small talk – I used to think they were superficial but I now see how they keep
articles.summary: A writer previously viewed large family gatherings and small talk as superficial. Large family gatherings once felt shallow to this writer, who thought real connection required an extended amount of time together and frequent deep conversations. Now, she sees how small talk, shared food, and simply showing up can keep loved ones close in a time-starved society. Large gatherings and small talk – I used to think they were superficial but I now see how they keep.

articles.title: How Australian-inspired design comes to life in Surabaya, Indonesia
articles.summary: Architect Giovanni Gunawan designed a home in Surabaya, Indonesia. The owner wanted the openness and honesty of Australian architecture, but building in tropical Surabaya demanded a different response. Architect Giovanni Gunawan blended the best of both worlds in a home centred on privacy, family living and the climate. How Australian-inspired design comes to life in Surabaya, Indonesia.

articles.title: AI is rewriting China’s filmmaking rulebook, but the script isn’t finished
articles.summary: China produced over 95 per cent of its new microdramas using More than 95 per cent of China's new microdramas in the first quarter of 2026 were AI-generated, compared with near zero a year ago. CNA speaks to the industry's key cast about the new plot twist. AI is rewriting China’s filmmaking rulebook, but the script isn’t finished.

articles.summary: Archaeologists in Egypt uncovered a well-preserved Byzantine-era city in the western desert's Dakhla oasis. articles.title: Why tanks still matter in modern warfare
articles.summary: Military experts state drones and precision weapons cannot achieve the ultimate objective of war: controlling territory Drones, missiles and precision-guided weapons have transformed the modern battlefield, but military experts argue they cannot achieve the ultimate objective of war – controlling territory. Saurabh Trivedi examines why tanks and ground forces remain indispensable despite the rapid evolution of warfare, drawing on lessons from Ukraine and insights from senior Army officers.

articles.title: Aung San Suu Kyi
articles.summary: Myanmar's junta has made territorial gains in the ongoing civil war. The junta, which has made some territorial gains in the civil war and held a farcical election to legitimise its coup, seeks international recognition, but it lacks what the NLD leader, now under house arrest, has always symbolised. popular support. Aung San Suu Kyi.

articles.title: Aid workers on life in Sudanese city pummelled by drone strikes
articles.summary: Drone attacks in El Obeid, Sudan, killed over 20 people, including students, this past weekend. Schools and fuel stations were hit in the city. articles.title: Tackling stigma on Uganda's Ebola frontline
articles.summary: Uganda's health workers are addressing fear and misinformation during an Ebola outbreak. As Uganda works to contain an Ebola outbreak that is also affecting neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), health workers are doing more than responding to a deadly virus. They are helping families navigate fear, misinformation and stigma. Tackling stigma on Uganda's Ebola frontline.

articles.title: Ukraine Is Winning Its War On Russian Oil Refineries. On The Front Line, It's A Bloody Slugfest.
articles.summary: Ukraine's drone attacks on Russian gasoline refineries caused nationwide shortages. Ukraine’s drone campaign on Russian gasoline refineries is wreaking havoc, leading to nationwide shortages, fraying tempers, and mounting headaches for the Kremlin. articles.title: European Conservatives Bring Unity Message To US: Ukraine Matters. Iran Does, Too
articles.summary: Senior European conservative lawmakers visited Washington to meet with the Trump administration. As NATO leaders prepare to gather for next week's summit, a group of senior European conservative lawmakers visited Washington with a message they hope will resonate inside the Trump administration: Support for Ukraine and concern over Iran are not mutually exclusive. European Conservatives Bring Unity Message To US: Ukraine Matters.

articles.title: Is Serbia's President Pulling A Putin-Medvedev Power Swap?
articles.summary: Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation as Serbia's president in the Aleksandar Vucic has announced his resignation in the "coming weeks." Burdened by almost two years of student-led protests, is Serbia's most powerful political figure under too much pressure or is this a calculated political play with another top job in sight? articles.title: Kyiv Mourns Victims Of Major Russian Drone And Missile Attack
articles.summary: Russia launched a major drone and missile attack on Kyiv on July 2. Kyiv residents mourned those killed in a Russian overnight attack on July 2 that marked one of the biggest strikes on the Ukrainian capital this year and left at least 30 people dead and nearly 100 more injured. Kyiv Mourns Victims Of Major Russian Drone And Missile Attack.

articles.summary: Trump administration officials believed Israel intended to assassinate Iran's top negotiators. articles.title: Sudan’s people subject to ‘relentless’ drone strikes in El Obeid
articles.summary: Volker Türk, the UN’s human rights chief, reported relentless drone attacks The war in Sudan threatens to spiral further as the strategically-important town of El Obeid continues to face “relentless” drone attacks by advancing paramilitary militias, the UN’s human rights chief, Volker Türk, said on Friday. Sudan’s people subject to ‘relentless’ drone strikes in El Obeid.

articles.title: El Niño forecast to intensify, increasing likelihood of extreme weather
articles.summary: The UN World Meteorological Organization reported strengthening El Niño conditions in the tropical Pacific. More blistering heatwaves and other weather extremes are becoming increasingly likely across the world now and in coming months, linked to strengthening El Niño conditions in the tropical Pacific, the UN World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said on Friday. El Niño forecast to intensify, increasing likelihood of extreme weather.

articles.title: Who's Shipping Bananas To Russia, And Who's Shipping Cocaine?
articles.summary: A Systema investigation found that banana shipments to St. Petersburg sometimes conceal cocaine. Shipments of bananas to St. Petersburg sometimes conceal a contraband cargo: cocaine. A Systema investigation finds that two companies with roles in the delivery and further distribution of the fruit are controlled by Russians with ties to longtime associates of President Vladimir Putin. Who's Shipping Bananas To Russia, And Who's Shipping Cocaine?

articles.title: ‘I can only describe it as a war zone’: the rescuers navigating Venezuela’s post-quake hellscape
articles.summary: Twin earthquakes hit Venezuela's northern coast last week. Thousands of volunteers are joined by overseas teams in the hope of finding more survivors in the rubble, reports Tom Phillips in Caraballeda. Photography and video by Manu QuinteroWhen twin earthquakes tore through Venezuela’s northern coast last week, Israel Rivas was at home hundreds of miles away in the industrial city of San Félix.

articles.title: As Iran Prepares Elaborate Funeral For Khamenei, Many Recall A Brutal Leader
articles.summary: Iran's government is preparing a multiday funeral for late Supreme Leader Ali Iran's government is preparing a multiday funeral ceremony for late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, who died in US and Israeli strikes in February. But many Iranians are not mourning his loss, and are instead sharing complex reactions to the death of a man who led an oppressive theocratic regime.

articles.title: Culture war killing America’s response to demographic decline
articles.summary: The Supreme Court affirmed birthright citizenship under the 14th Amendment. This grants automatic US citizenship to anyone born in the country. It includes children of undocumented immigrants and temporary visa holders, groups the Trump administration had aimed to exclude. Birthright citizenship is the law of the land. The Supreme Court has once again ruled that the 14th Amendment gives automatic citizenship to anyone born in the US.

articles.summary: 5 जुलाई 1977 को पाकिस्तान में सेना प्रमुख जिया उल हक ने सत्ता संभाली। आज ही के दिन यानी 5 जुलाई और साल था 1977, जब पाकिस्तान की राजनीति में सेना का दखल बढ़ा था. प्रधानमंत्री जुल्फिकार अली भुट्टो को सत्ता से हटाकर सेना प्रमुख जिया उल हक ने सत्ता अपने हाथ में ली थी. इसी के साथ पाकिस्तान में लोकतंत्र का खात्मा और सैनिक युग शुरू हुआ.

articles.title: बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने डोनाल्ड ट्रंप को लगाया फोन, अगले हफ्ते व्हाइट हाउस में हो सकती है मीटिंग
articles.summary: इजरायल के प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने शुक्रवार को अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति अमेरिका (United States of America) के 250वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस के अवसर पर कई राष्ट्राध्यक्षों ने अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप (Donald Trump) को बधाई दी, जिनमें इज़रायल (Israel) के पीएम बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू (Benjamin Netanyahu) भी शामिल है। शुक्रवार को नेतन्याहू ने ट्रंप से फोन पर बात की, जिसके बारे में खुद अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ने शनिवार को एक इंटरव्यू के दौरान बताया।

articles.title: फिर 9/11 जैसी तबाही देखेगा अमेरिका? पाकिस्तान से गलबहियां कर दुनिया को खतरे में डाल रहे डोनाल्ड
articles.summary: एक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, अमेरिका क्षेत्रीय रणनीतिक हितों के नाम पर पाकिस्तान को राजनीतिक संरक्षण दे रहा है। रिपोर्ट का दावा है कि अमेरिका एक बार फिर क्षेत्रीय रणनीतिक हितों के नाम पर पाकिस्तान को राजनीतिक संरक्षण दे रहा है, जबकि पाकिस्तान के भीतर लोकतांत्रिक संस्थाओं के कमजोर होने, मानवाधिकार उल्लंघनों और सेना के बढ़ते प्रभाव को नजरअंदाज किया जा रहा है.
